name: Senir's Observations
summary: Grelin Whitebeard's report reaches his brother Senir in Kharanos, carrying news from Coldridge Valley. Its arrival sends Senir back to watching hostile forces across the snowfields.

sections.title: Through the Tunnel to Kharanos
sections.body: Mountaineer Thalos guards the gate out of Coldridge Valley. He entrusts passing travelers with Grelin's dispatch. Beyond the gate, violent troggs ambush those crossing the tunnel and make the passage to Kharanos dangerous. Past the tunnel, the main road runs through central Dun Morogh to town.

sections.title: A Grumpy Welcome and Senate Politics
sections.body:
At the Thunderbrew Distillery, Senir Whitebeard warms himself over drinks when Grelin's report arrives. He chuckles at his brother's forceful words. Grelin invokes King Magni Bronzebeard to press for urgent action, Senir says, and that will agitate the stubborn Ironforge Senate.

The bitter cold has kept Senir from filing his own observations. Grelin's dispatch sends him back to watching hostile forces across the snowfields.

faq.q: Why is Mountaineer Thalos having a traveler deliver the report?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos guards the Coldridge Valley tunnel against aggressive troggs and cannot leave his post. When a traveler passes through, he entrusts them with Grelin's dispatch for Kharanos.
Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven scout and Grelin Whitebeard's brother. He is stationed in Kharanos, gathering field reports on local threats for Ironforge's high command.

Grelin's report records his findings on Frostmane troll activity and incursions in Coldridge Valley. He invokes King Magni Bronzebeard's authority to press the authorities for reinforcements and attention.

faq.q: Why does Senir say Grelin's report will ruffle feathers in the Senate?
faq.answer: Grelin invokes King Magni's name forcefully to demand action. That can challenge the Ironforge Senate's authority and pride, irritating members who favor formal deliberation.

faq.q: Why is the tunnel between Coldridge Valley and Kharanos dangerous?
aliases: why are troggs in the tunnel
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs have emerged from deep subterranean cracks and seized the mountain tunnel. They attack dwarven travelers, merchants and messengers who try to pass.

faq.q: Where does the road lead after delivering this message?
faq.answer: Kharanos brings travelers into Dun Morogh's wider defense. Senir Whitebeard seeks help investigating Frostmane and trogg threats, while town leaders direct aid toward Brewnall Village, Ironforge and the outlying farms.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you leave the sheltered training valley for Kharanos and take a first step into Khaz Modan's defense. There, field scouts' concerns meet the Ironforge Senate's caution.
As a gnome, you travel through the pass to Kharanos and draw closer to Dun Morogh's main hubs and efforts to support your dwarven hosts.
Coordinated scouting helps keep Dun Morogh secure while Stormwind is caught up in domestic strife and cannot spare aid for its northern allies.
